semanticChecks.method: Direct field-by-field author review of both locale texts against Japanese source, without peer files.
semanticChecks.coverage: Full text of all paragraphs, titles, prompts, glossary terms and two illustration alt texts; no summaries.
semanticChecks.conditionsAndNegations: Preserved distinctions between nominal and measured diameter, length and end-face condition, component fit and machining suitability, visual cleaning and degreasing, tightening and sealing, tacking and completed welding, mechanical retention and sealing, insertion marking and actual insertion, holding and curing,lining and exposed-end corrosion protection.
semanticChecks.uncertainty: Kept product-specific compatibility, thermal/deformation impact possibility, not-all welding methods and PVC adhesive suitability qualifications. Unreceived/unconfirmed/no-record report states retained.
semanticChecks.numbers: All sorted ASCII numeric tokens validated against each source field. Source contains no ASCII numeric operating limits. Spelled-out counts rendered as words; A/B and V/Y/I designations preserved where present.
semanticChecks.technicalTerms: Reviewed nominal diameter,wall thickness,thread cutting/die head/chaser/thread gauge,degreasing/sealant/tape,shielded electrode arc welding/flux/bevel/tack welding,mechanical coupling/housing/gasket,rigid PVC/chamfer/burr/insertion depth,lined steel pipe/corrosion protection/reamer/scraper/jig.
semanticChecks.finalCorrections: Changed Traditional Chinese threading verb from a turning-specific expression to neutral thread cutting to avoid imposing an unsupported machining method. Clarified oxidation/defect blanket-prevention negation.
semanticChecks.sourceOnlyScope: No torque values,tape wrap counts,timing,pressure tests,tool installation steps,bevel percentages or extra safety requirements added.

limitations: Self-review only; no independent native-language or engineering approval.
